sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-Sema6A and anti-HA immunostaining confirmed expression; overall retinal lamination unaffected in homozygous knock-in mice — function preserved.
sites.rationale: L2 explicitly states the HA tag was knocked in 'downstream of the signal peptide in exon 2 at the N-terminus of the extracellular domain of Sema6A' in a full-length membrane-anchored construct. The signal peptide spans residues 1–18 (last residue A at position 18), so the tag sits after residue 18 and before the mature N-terminus at residue 19 (G); Python confirms residue_before='A', residue_after='G'. The junction is 631 residues from the TM boundary (TM starts at 650), well clear of any structural constraint. L1/L3 confirm expression and immunostaining; L4 independently corroborates the same exon-2 N-terminal position with a 3xHA tag; L5/L6 corroborate with an N-terminal myc tag showing surface display and preserved PlexinA2 engagement. Sema6a HA-F knock-in allele: HA epitope tag inserted downstream of the signal peptide in exon 2 at the N-terminus of the extracellular domain of full-length, membrane-anchored Sema6A in mouse. Homozygous Sema6a HA-F/HA-F retinas were examined by anti-Sema6A and anti-HA immunostaining. Corroborated by L4 (3xHA in exon 2, PMC10703890) and L5/L6 (N-terminal myc tag on full-length Sema6A, surface expression and PlexinA2 binding confirmed, PMC4938514).

sources.claim: In Sema6a HA-F , a hemagglutinin (HA) tag was knocked in downstream of the signal peptide in exon 2 at the N-terminus of the extracellular domain of Sema6A.

literature_notes: L4 (PMC10703890, 3xHA in exon 2) independently corroborates the same insert_after_residue=18 junction and could serve as a co-primary citation; L2 was chosen as the single supporting_clip_id because it most explicitly names the landmark ('downstream of the signal peptide in exon 2'). L5/L6 (PMC4938514, N-terminal myc tag) also corroborate: no residue is named, but the only extracellular terminus of this type-I single-pass protein is after the signal peptide, making the position topology_derived to the same junction; surface expression and PlexinA2 binding were confirmed, adding functional validation. L7 (3xFLAG C-terminus) and L8/L9 (C-terminal GFP) describe tags at the intracellular C-terminus (residue 1030, within IC domain 674–1030) and are recorded in other_positions. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by any ledger line.

literature_other_positions.note: 3xFLAG tag with EFGSGSGS linker at the C-terminus of full-length SEMA6A; the C-terminus falls within the intracellular domain (residues 674–1030), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.

GFP fused to the C-terminus of full-length Sema6A (Sema6a-GFP); surface expression of the protein was confirmed by anti-SEMA6A staining on non-permeabilised cells, but the GFP moiety itself is intracellular (C-terminus in IC domain 674–1030).
